notes_for_editor: Only a map location, a listing and OpenStreetMap tags were found. No build date, builder, staffing, fires or current condition in any source. The lattice construction and observation use come from OpenStreetMap tags alone. Elevation 194 ft (59 m) agrees between TopoZone and the tnlandforms list. Not on the Wikipedia list, NHLR or FFLOS. The Anyplace America page returned HTTP 403 and was not read. The story is about 70 words, well below the roughly 120-word guide, because the sources support no more; the editor may hold or drop it.
